title: longest unbeaten runs.
question: Which European club went the longest without losing a league game?

items.name: Celtic
items.fact: A century later Celtic went 56 unbeaten again, in 2016–17.

items.name: Sheriff Tiraspol
items.fact: Moldova's Sheriff went 63 league games without a defeat.

items.name: Red Star Belgrade
items.fact: Red Star appear three times on this list: 65, 57 and 55 games.

items.name: Lincoln Red Imps
items.fact: Gibraltar's Lincoln Red Imps went unbeaten in the league from 2009 to 2014.

items.name: Steaua București
items.fact: No league defeat for 104 games, from 1986 to 1989.

ending: AC Milan's 58 from 1991 to 1993 is the best run from Europe's big five leagues.
